title: Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Summary:
  
  
Speedcast is a leading global provider of managed communications and IT services, delivering high-availability hybrid WAN, edge compute, and SaaS solutions across maritime, rail, energy, cruise, and enterprise markets. Our Edge Platform combines SD-WAN, edge orchestration, and multi-orbit satellite and terrestrial connectivity into a unified managed service that customers depend on in the world’s most demanding environments.
  
  
The Implementation Engineer is the named technical owner of a service from the moment the approved solution design is handed over, through build, commissioning and hypercare. The role pairs hands-on technical depth with delivery rigour: you will configure and commission Speedcast’s solutions, and you will produce work packs and as-built records to ensure every deployment is efficient, meets the needs of the customer and is supportable through its life.
  
  
You will work to standards wherever possible, utilizing published product baselines, templates and zero-touch profiles; your engineering effort goes into the difference between the baseline and the customer’s design, into exceptions, and into the field evidence that improves the next version. If you love solving a wide variety of customer problems in the most demanding situations and remote locations, want to contribute to making the complex repeatable and want to be part of a global team striving to be the best partner for our customers, this role is for you.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Technical Ownership of Delivered Services
  
  

* Act as the technical owner for each service you implement, from handover of the approved solution design through hypercare.
* Accept the solution design at handover: confirm it is complete and deliverable, and return gaps to Solutions Engineering before build starts rather than absorbing ambiguity during delivery.
* Lead customer deployments, onboarding and migrations of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration and SD-WAN platforms, acting as the technical point of contact for configuration, testing and go-live support, and referring any change to the design back to Solutions Engineering.
* Hand over to operations before hypercare closes: runbooks, monitoring, as-built records and Business Service and CMDB records complete and accurate.
* Take part in out-of-hours go-lives and the support rotation when required..
* Act as the engineering escalation point for the services you deployed, supporting the NOC and support organisation.

Build, Configure and Commission to Standard
  
  

* Implement to the approved solution design and the published product baselines and templates. Use pre-configured hardware and zero-touch provisioning wherever the baseline allows, and direct engineering effort to the delta between the baseline and the customer’s design.
* Configure and commission Sigma (Versa SD-WAN, Zededa edge orchestration, the Sigma VM including its local dashboard, OBM tools, Voice Services, and CrewXP) together with the connectivity beneath it: Starlink, OneWeb, GEO, MSS, LTE/5G, and terrestrial circuits.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, applications, and networks.
* Commission remotely wherever possible. Coordinate with field engineers, third-party installers and customer self-install, and validate results against the acceptance criteria so the service is right the first time.
* Validate hardware and configuration against the approved solution design and the baseline before dispatch, working with Project Managers and other stakeholders so that services are delivered to the agreed scope.
* Deploy and validate customer and third-party containerised or virtualised workloads on edge nodes, and bring them under the standard monitoring and change processes.

Delivery Documentation and Bill of Materials
  
  

* Own the delivery Bill of Materials from handover to close-out: start from the baseline or solution BoM, ensure the physical delivery components are correct (cabling, mounting, power, consumables), validate it against the approved solution design, and keep it under version control. Raise discrepancies with Solutions Engineering before procurement is initiated.
* Produce installation instructions, work packs and connectivity drawings, generated from baseline templates, with only the delta authored by hand. Review before issue to field teams.
* Produce the as-built pack at close-out, capturing any deviation from the design, and keep it consistent with the Business Service and CMDB records.
* Act as the technical reference for Project Managers and Customer Success Managers: explain scope, hardware and configuration, and flag technical risks and blockers early.

Change and Incident Management
  
  

* Execute changes through the standard change templates and tiers. Non-standard or chargeable changes follow the gated process (tier, time and type) so that work is scoped and priced before it is scheduled.
* Run fleet-level campaigns (for example operating system, firmware and configuration rollouts) in the agreed stages, and handle site-level exceptions.
* Resolve incidents and technical problems on the services you own, using runbooks, and capture root cause and rework attribution so that recurring faults are fixed at source.
* Keep records (project, change and incident tasks) accurate and complete, including effort and outcome, so that demand and rework can be understood and the process improved.

Standards, Automation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Feed field evidence back to Platforms & Standards Engineering: where the design or a baseline did not fit, why, and what the delta was. Propose improvements and take part in field validation of new baselines.
* Identify manual steps in delivery and raise them with Platforms & Standards Engineering as automation requirements, with the evidence (frequency, effort, failure modes). The Data and AI team owns automation delivery with other contributors; you use it and validate it in the field.
* Document procedures, configurations and lessons learned, and contribute to the knowledge base and runbook library with the Platform Owners.
* Mentor and cross-train colleagues, and take part in customer workshops for large-scale or complex rollouts.
* Use approved AI tools to speed up documentation and troubleshooting, and share what works with the team.

Academic Qualifications:
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or HND/HNC in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Networking, Telecommunications, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal qualification.
  
  
Experience:
  
  
Essential:
  
  

* 3+ years in edge or network implementation, deployment engineering, project engineering, or field and network operations, with a record of delivering complex deployments end to end.
* Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (for example Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass), and zero-touch provisioning.
* Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (for example Zededa, KVM, Proxmox, VMware).
* Experience with cloud providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration and SSO setup.
* Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption and measured boot.
* Working knowledge of Linux system troubleshooting
* Familiarity with containerization; Docker, Kubernetes, cloud container services (AWS/Azure)
* Strong networking fundamentals: routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, QoS, firewalls, DNS, NAT and proxies, on both physical and virtual interfaces.
* Proficiency with network diagnostic tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables and netstat.
* Demonstrated experience producing delivery documentation (installation instructions, work packs, connectivity drawings, as-built records) and working with Bills of Materials for hardware-intensive deployments.
* Working knowledge of network hardware (routers, switches, terminals, antennas, cabling) and the ability to read and produce topology and connectivity diagrams.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to document issues clearly, escalate appropriately and work across global teams.
* Experience with technical drawing tools (Visio, Lucidchart or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have:
  
  

* Experience with satellite communications across GEO, MEO and LEO constellations, including terminal commissioning.
* Comfortable with REST APIs and tools such as Postman, curl and Python scripting for automation and testing; familiarity with Ansible, Terraform or Bash.
* Prior experience deploying and managing SD-WAN; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira or equivalent ITSM tools for project, change and incident management.
* Experience in rail, retail, industrial, construction, maritime, energy or other remote and offshore deployment environments.

Certifications (advantageous):
  
  

* Edge Orchestration certifications (for example Zededa ZCEA/ZCEP).
* SD-WAN certifications (for example Versa VNX100/301/400/125)
* Cloud Certifications (for example AWS Solutions or Engineering)
* Kubernetes (CKA), Linux (for example RHCSA or LFCS)
* Networking certifications (for example Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Palo Alto).

Desirable:
  
  

* Additional working languages — French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, or Arabic — are an advantage in Speedcast’s multi-national operating environment.

Skills and competencies:
  
  

* Ownership: takes accountability for a service from handover to the end of hypercare, and is comfortable being the named owner.
* Standards discipline: works to the approved solution design and the published baselines, and reports where they do not fit rather than quietly designing around them.
* Documentation precision: produces clear, complete and consistent documents that field and operations teams can act on without coming back for clarification.
* Automation awareness: recognises a repeated manual step and reports it with the evidence needed to automate it.
* Collaborative: works effectively with Solutions Engineers, Platform Owners, Customer Success, operations and field teams, adjusting communication to the audience.
* Composure under pressure: keeps clear stakeholder communication during incidents and go-lives.

**Working at Speedcast:**
At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. **What We’re Looking For…**

* Supporting daily operations, including internal/external stakeholder engagement and dotted-line leadership.
* Performing the end-to-end migration of the critical network management systems and IT tools into newly established, secure network zones; ensuring compliance with security vulnerabilities and risk benchmarks.
* Developing comprehensive migration strategies and dependency maps to transition tools into cloud-native frameworks with zero business disruption.
* Building automated pipelines and "Golden Config" security frameworks required for new and rapid data center zone deployment.
* Leading security configuration standards and technical oversight for core infrastructure (routers, switches, and firewalls) while collaborating with stakeholders to map traffic flows and optimize DNS and load balancing for seamless service cutovers.
* Architecting CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows using AI/Copilot frameworks and scripting to streamline repetitive tasks and enhance infrastructure scalability.
* Integrating firewalls, proxies, and identity-based security policies (IAM) across network segments to protect critical management systems and tools.
* Validating hardware through stress testing to ensure a hardened network posture across all infrastructure (Wi-Fi, Retail systems, Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancers)
* Designing Low Level Design (LLD) diagrams and maintaining physical topology knowledge to communicate security boundaries to implementation teams.
* Establishing strategic roadmaps and technical standards to ensure secure, scalable, and high-performance network deployments.
* Providing technical leadership and mentorship to the engineering team while promoting a culture of accountability and collaborative problem-solving.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
* Four or more years of experience managing core enterprise networking primitives: DNS, ADC/Load Balancing (F5/Citrix), and IP Address Management (IPAM).
* Demonstrated production-grade network automation expertise: Hands-on proficiency using Python and Ansible to build configuration pipelines, automate deployments, and drive infrastructure scaling.
* Practical experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning toolsets, or generative/Copilot frameworks to network workflows, automation pipelines, or infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Strong hands-on background in enterprise network security architecture, including firewall integration, policy enforcement, and infrastructure segmentation.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Prior experience leading complex application migrations and data center consolidation projects.
* Experience building fault-tolerant architectures and micro-segmentation within Zero Trust (SASE/SSE) frameworks.
* Deep expertise in Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), proxies, VPNs, and IAM, specifically regarding management traffic security.
* Technical proficiency with enterprise logging and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, Zabbix, SevOne).
* Strong understanding of operating systems (Linux/Windows) and how they interact with network infrastructure.
* Strong alignment with NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS benchmarks across cloud-native and hybrid environments.
* Certifications like: CISSP, CCSP, CCIE Security or related SASE certifications.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

* Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

* Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.
